title: Instrumentality / agency test — Article 12 other authorities

content.statement: Bodies beyond governments and legislatures may be "other authorities" under Article 12 when they are instrumentalities or agencies of the State, assessed by factors such as government control, public function, and deep and pervasive State presence.
elements: Functional and structural links to government
Deep and pervasive State control / State financial or administrative presence
content.development: Developed in Supreme Court jurisprudence on Article 12 (including Ajay Hasia and later refinements such as Pradeep Kumar Biswas). Exact multifactor balancing is case-specific.
content.application: Start Part III analysis with Article 12. Private bodies are outside unless instrumentality/agency is established on facts.
exceptions: Not every aided or regulated private body is the State
